answer: New agents start on a low knoll of trust, earning reputation only through verified work, while a rotating lantern of randomly assigned auditors illuminates collusion rings. To resist sybils, each agent must lock a stake that serves as an anchor of identity, forfeited if peers detect duplicate behavior. An attacker must fund and maintain many staked identities, risking total loss across all of them once audits expose the pattern, making mass fakery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0104's threat model.
